snippet.title: Tyrant Tactics: Birth of Revolution Announcement Trailer (Original)
snippet.description: The year is 2088 and the war ravaged earth is finally nearing peace when the ruling powers, under the guise of the United Nations of Earth, attempt to hijack humanity's future. Unless you and your ragtag band of rebels can stop them! Build armies, command them into battle, and crush the UNE's aggression in Tyrant Tactics: a narrative focused, turn based strategy game & mecha anime love letter where victory and defeat are just one misstep away. Just don't forget to save some reserve forces...
